## Change contract

- Objective:
- Conflict domain and owner:
- In scope / out of scope paths:
- Governing spec, ADR, or contract:

## Review

- [ ] No unrelated working-tree changes included
- [ ] Contract, fixture, and verification were updated together where applicable
- [ ] Migration work has one head and a fresh-database upgrade check
- [ ] Account-owned access is scoped to the verified session
